name: pytorch-adk
description: Complete PyTorch ADK — 22 agents, 25 skills, 11 hooks, MCP configs, and index-building tools.
prerequisites: Target directory must be a PyTorch git checkout
Python venv at <project>/venv/ with PyTorch installed
Run tools/adk/build_index.py after install to populate the index
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var set if using llm_gap_fill for unresolved edges
